directory_policies.notes.9: Cost context: On-campus professional engineering tuition is USD 30,720 per semester; approved part-time tuition is USD 2,560 per credit, capped at that semester amount. Three semesters is typical, not a verified maximum bill. The USD 1,700 online MCS rate is excluded; total tuition stays pending.

fact_summary: The professional engineering table distinguishes full-time semester tuition from approved part-time per-credit billing, and separately itemizes fees. A typical three-semester duration is not a compulsory billing schedule or verified upper bound.
